normal.name: Robrobo64
normal.text: My childhood video game console is now 2 decades old. I remember getting this on Christmas, don't know when since it was a long time ago.
normal.media: quotes @toonhive.bsky.social: 20 years ago today, the Nintendo Wii launched.

normal.text: I'm so old that I PC game exclusively. I remember being so young and wanting to play the original Smash Bros before its release that I wish I could have slept for 7 months to pass the time. Now, I won't even go in for a few extra shifts to buy a [current version of Xbox] to play GTA 6

normal.name: Rebecca “Becky” Karen Cassandra Dunning-Kruger
normal.text: Now which did I learn to do first? a. Ride a horse in two way traffic in Valentine, New Hanover in a video game while being baited by roadside NPCs b. Drive a car and get my license in real life c. Operate a car with two gears (forward and reverse) in Los Santos, San Andreas in a video game

normal.name: Moctezuma III
normal.text: And throughout these shifts... what happened to GTA? When Zuck announced the metaverse, the first VR game for it was, as he put it, "The Classic Video Game, Grand Theft Auto San Andreas". The crime simulator was the platforms big release. GTA was now 'classic', normal, without controversy or edge.

normal.name: Alice Valentine
normal.text: I've always been a big fan of what would now be called retro games, which... given I'm 41 and the first video game I remember playing is Phantasy Star on the Master System shouldn't shock anyone. I've never considered myself beholden to nostalgia and love modern games, but classics are classics.

normal.name: Rotating Handles
normal.text: I mean I literally cannot buy GTA 6 until it comes out on PC because I don't have a console that can run it but like...gotta be the first GTA game that gets people who LIKE IT quoting Bell Hooks right?

normal.name: Unpleasant Ghoul
normal.text: #ghoul_yaps That was Allods Online! (It has an English localization, though only text is translated, but I never got around to trying that because it's, like. My whole childhood!) I think anyone from Azeroth could survive there, to be honest. The dangers may be different, but their... Level, so>

normal.name: Thomas Wittenburg
normal.text: Hvis jeg havde en Playstation 5, ville jeg tage fri i en uge for at spille det nye GTA. Men det har jeg ikke. I stedet vil jeg nu sende den tiårige tidligt i seng, og gå på genopdagelse i GTA 2. retroonline.net/Windows/Gran...

normal.name: nora-vember has come
normal.text: Mint is great for this! i've found some tools needed for ROM patching are hard to get running on Linux, and some very old PC games, but everything else has been a breeze! and Linux is just very fun in general

normal.name: BERSERKER
normal.text: bruhhh i still have this big fat crt tv that i refuse to get rid of from my childhood that i use specifically for the wii/gcn/n64 because retro games kinda look like pants on modern flatscreens

normal.name: Sasha's Retrobytes 🏳️‍⚧️
normal.text: My history with the Wii is one of those examples that you don't need nostalgia to get into and love an old console. I never had or played a Wii back then, not until picking one up on a whim in 2022, looking for a new console to explore. And it's one of the best decisions I ever made.
normal.media: 2 images: A photo from the launch in 2006 with someone dressed as Mario with a blue Wii tee holding up a boxed Wii at EB Games / A photo of a midnight launch clock counter with a sea of people's heads in shot
